crestFix: Tested Chromium could not decode the existing ICO as an img, while the existing 192px PNG decoded. Local fallback branding now uses that PNG; configured Discord branding is unchanged. Every final browser visit asserts crest decoding.
testMethod: Original downloaded MP4 bytes are fulfilled at their original CDN URLs with HTTP byte-range support; real Chromium H.264 decoder, play/pause/timeupdate/ended events and CSS fades. HEAD/download separately verified against live CDN. Playback rejection/deadline, failed requests and saveData/visibility flags are controlled negative scenarios.
limits: Original JavaScript is not embedded in the MHTML, so the controller is an independent implementation of its observed three-video system and supplied CSS transitions.
Final source release streams the three original URLs from Blizzard CDN, as the reference does; videos are not bundled into the archive.
Physical iOS/Android and uninterrupted live-CDN playback were not tested; mobile viewport and exact downloaded media bytes were tested.
Live Discord OAuth, emergency-token POST, PostgreSQL and deployment were not performed.
Full CI passed before the final failed-source release and PNG fallback changes; final ESLint, TypeScript, production build, browser 29/29 and standalone6/6 passed afterwards.
